what: a loft between a 40 mm and a 20 mm square 80 mm apart, shelled 2 mm open at the small end
method: a ruled loft of two squares is a square pyramid frustum (4 planar walls). Outer V=80/3*(1600+800+400). Walls offset 2 normal to the faces: tan(a)=10/80, half-width w(z)=20-z/8-2/cos(a), floor at z=2, cavity a frustum of height 78 with areas (2w(2))^2 and (2w(80))^2: V=outer-78/3*(A1+sqrt(A1*A2)+A2); faces 4 outer walls + base + top ring + 4 inner walls + floor = 11
